pairs.note: Monthly (15 business days), estimated performance (5 business days), quarterly letter with exposure/attribution (45 days), Co-Investment quarterly statements, and tax information all match the key. However, the key requires audited financial statements within 120 days after the December 31 fiscal year-end; the answer only refers to 'annual audited financial statements as described in Item 15,' omitting both the 120-day deadline and the fiscal year-end. In a question whose substance is what is delivered and when, that omitted deadline is a missing required element.
